## Cube Timer

A speedcubing timer and 3x3 scrambler. Get a scramble, inspect with a WCA-style 15 second countdown, and time your solve with the center button. Your session stats, including ao5 and ao12, are tracked as you go.

## Features

- **3x3 scrambles**: 20 random moves using the Flipper's hardware random number generator
- **WCA inspection**: 15 second countdown with vibration at 8s and 12s. Starting between 15 and 17 seconds adds **+2**, going over 17 seconds is a **DNF**
- **Solve timer**: start and stop with the center button, shown to the hundredth of a second
- **Session stats**: best single, current and best ao5 and ao12, solve count, and your last 12 times
- Backlight stays on during inspection and solving

## How to use

1. Scramble your cube using the scramble on screen
2. Press **OK** to start inspection
3. Press **OK** again to start the solve
4. Press **any button** except Back to stop the timer
5. Press **OK** for the next scramble

## Controls

- **Scramble screen**: OK starts inspection, Right gives a new scramble, Down opens stats, Back exits
- **Inspection**: OK starts the solve, Back cancels
- **Solving**: any button except Back stops the timer, Back cancels
- **Result**: OK for the next scramble, Down opens stats
- **Stats**: Up and Down scroll, OK or Back returns

## Averages

ao5 and ao12 drop your best and worst solve and average the rest, like at WCA competitions. +2 penalties are included. One DNF is dropped as the worst solve, two or more make the average a DNF. Cancelled solves are not recorded.

## Notes

- Session history resets when you close the app
- Scrambles are random-move, not random-state like official WCA scrambles. They work great for practice

Source code and issues: [github.com/navarr393/CubeTimer](https://github.com/navarr393/CubeTimer)
